finds.title: Main Street Bridge
finds.blurb: Today's bridge crosses the freeway. Until the 1950s, an arched bridge of 1906 crossed the creek here.

finds.title: The Mill Annex
finds.blurb: This stone store-room of 1880 is all that remains of the four-storey flour mill James Alexander Forbes built in the 1850s.

finds.title: The High School
finds.blurb: The main building was dedicated in 1925, designed by W. H. Weeks, on its rise of lawn above Main Street.

finds.title: Town Plaza
finds.blurb: Under the old cedar, you find your voice. Tap Meow and people nearby stop to say hello.

finds.title: A beret
finds.blurb: Left on the kerb outside the theatre. It fits rather well.

finds.title: Reading glasses
finds.blurb: Someone's spare pair, by the library steps. Very distinguished.

finds.title: A daisy chain
finds.blurb: Woven by somebody on the creek bank and left for whoever came by.

finds.title: The Carousel
finds.blurb: Built for San Francisco's 1915 exposition, and restored here by volunteers.

finds.title: An engineer's neckerchief
finds.blurb: Red, a little sooty, and just your size. The steam train has run in this park since 1970.

finds.title: Vasona Lake
finds.blurb: Pedal boats, kayaks and little sailboats go out from here in the warm months. There is a rowing boat at the pier.

finds.title: Vasona Dam
finds.blurb: The north end of the lake. Look back: the whole town lies between here and the mountains.
